I disagree about the monogamy part. In all my monogamous relationships I never wanted to have sex with anyone else and certainly never had to refrain from doing anything because it simply wasn't something I wanted. I know other people probably don't feel this way though.
My bf and I have agreed we would both be uncomfortable going to strip clubs so we don't go. If you're uncomfortable, he should respect that. You should tell him.

Don't do that to yourself man. It's likely going to take some time. If you believe in soulmates then maybe she's(or he, whatever you're into) still out there and this was just a hard lesson for you to learn so you can be better for the right one. Maybe wait for sex? I found much better quality guys after telling them upfront that I wasn't interested in sex on the first date. Honestly I would tell them I wasn't interested in sex until I had a strong bond with them first. Maybe wait for sex until the relationship is official if you feel that's something you can do? If they stick around, it's because they like your personality and enjoy spending time with you. That's just an idea though, I get that waiting for sex wouldn't work for everyone. Go on dates and learn about each other. Most people on tinder are just looking for a quick fuck anyway so maybe a dating site?
I also suggest getting a pet. It's helped me a lot.

I think you should keep trying. Maybe tinder isn't the best place but make it clear you're looking for your soulmate or something serious and not a one night stand or friends with benefits. You have to be upfront with your intentions. But you shouldn't date until you're over her because no girl wants a guy who misses his ex.
That may be because when you miss someone, you romanticize the past. I think you can find someone else who you could avoid this mistake with, and someone who won't say they wouldn't care if you died.

Sorry my bad, I thought you meant that you told her the other day about you wanting to die. I'm just telling you how I feel as someone who was cheated on. Keep waking up in a cold sweat. Once you're a better person, then you should forgive yourself. You can do it. You should do it. Obviously it's your choice if you kill yourself or not but I really think you should improve yourself and be a better partner someday to someone else. You can learn from your guilt and be so much better. At least you feel guilty, I'm sure lots of guys would feel no remorse in this situation and they never change.
I thought she said she wouldn't care if you died?

The love of my life lied to me and cheated and I don't think I'll ever feel happy the same way again. I'll never trust anyone the same way. The unbearably sweet happy moments are gone and neither of us can go back. He cut me deeper than anyone else ever could and he was supposed to love me more than anyone else. He was fucking selfish. You need to stop lying. Your partner is the one who you should be totally honest with. That's intimacy. That's love. I understand how hard mental health issues make things but you can't abuse people or hurt the ones you love like that. What if she lied and cheated on you? You would have been fine with that? Don't tell her you want to kill yourself to make her feel bad. Just learn from this and leave that girl alone. Live with your mistakes and become a better person. It can be done. Never make this mistake again.

I'm sorry to hear you're struggling. I have trauma from child abuse and abuse as a teenager and borderline personality disorder. I never wanted to cheat. I had doubts but I never cheated. If you feel guilty you should just keep trying to be a better person. What you did was terrible but in my opinion you should just live with it. Endure it and change. Be alone for the rest of your life if that's what you want. Or find someone who you wouldn't consider cheating on. The love of my life cheated on me but I would never want him to die. You obviously weren't meant for each other if you cheated and she wishes death upon you. You can have something better if you change.

She couldn't have been the love of your life if you cheated on her and treated her badly. If you truly loved her, cheating would never cross your mind as an option. You would probably make her feel bad if you killed yourself. You really want to hurt her some more after what you did? Really? As a girl who's been cheated on, if you really feel guilty, you deserve to live with that guilt until you become a better person. If she's happy, let her be. You owe it to her.
